project: Namias Portfolio — Blog Content Strategy & Image System
owner: Jhon Keneth Ryan B. Namias (PP Namias)
summary: Expand the portfolio blog from 3 to 12+ posts with a quick inline image system (with credits/captions), image collage support, staggered publishing dates for natural progression, and a content strategy built around interview storytelling.
narrative: The portfolio currently has 3 blog posts all published on the same day (June 5, 2026), zero inline images in the body, no collage/gallery support, and thin content. This PRD addresses all of that with a two-track approach: (1) a quick inline image system that preserves Sanity image blocks through the pipeline with credit/caption/source/license metadata, and (2) a simple image collage gallery block type for multi-photo layouts. The content plan adds 9+ new posts spanning from 2025 to 2026, organized by interview storytelling themes. Dates are staggered to show a natural content progression that demonstrates growth, technical depth, and communication skills.
principles: Quick wins first — inline images with credits before complex collage features
Editor-friendly — authors add images in Sanity with alt/caption/credit, everything renders automatically
Interview storytelling — every post serves as a talking point for hiring manager conversations
Natural timeline — staggered dates show content growth over months, not a single day dump
No comments in code — documentation lives in the PRD and the blog content strategy MD
Type-safe and tested — tsc, eslint, vitest, and react-doctor stay green

designDecisions.rationale: Minimal pipeline change — standard markdown image syntax with metadata packed into the alt field. Parsed by a custom react-markdown img component. No new syntax or data structures needed.

designDecisions.choice: Figcaption below image showing caption + credit italicized + source link + license
designDecisions.rationale: Follows semantic HTML (figure/figcaption). Keeps metadata visible but unobtrusive. All fields optional — only render what's filled.

designDecisions.choice: Custom `imageGallery` array member in blockContent schema with layout picker
designDecisions.rationale: Sanity-native — editors can add galleries directly in the Portable Text editor. No custom markdown parsing needed for basic case. Falls back to sequential single images if gallery block isn't available.

designDecisions.choice: Backdate existing posts to realistic dates, schedule new posts with publishedAt field
designDecisions.rationale: Uses existing Sanity `publishedAt` + `publishAt` fields. Scheduled-publish function already handles auto-publishing. No new scheduling infrastructure.

designDecisions.choice: All inline images render at 800px max-width, responsive, with object-cover
designDecisions.rationale: Consistent look across all posts. Blog layout is max-w-container with readable line lengths — 800px images fit perfectly. Larger images would require clicking to expand (future enhancement).

epics.title: Schema — Inline Image Fields & Gallery

stories.title: Add credit/source/license to inline image schema
stories.details: Edit studio/schemaTypes/blockContent.ts. Add `credit` (string), `source` (url), `license` (string) fields to the image array member's fields array.

stories.title: Add imageGallery collage block type
stories.details: Add `imageGallery` as a new array member in blockContent.ts. Fields: `images` (array of images with alt/caption/credit), `layout` (string: 2col | 3col).

epics.title: Pipeline — Preserve Images & Galleries
epics.summary: Update both portableTextToMarkdown() implementations to emit image and gallery markers.

stories.title: Update portableTextToMarkdown in cms-content.server.ts
stories.details: Add detection of `_type === 'image'` blocks. Emit `![alt|caption|credit|source|license](url)`. Add detection of `_type === 'imageGallery'` blocks. Emit `[gallery:2col]` or `[gallery:3col]` wrapper with embedded image markers.

stories.title: Update portableTextToMarkdown in blog.server.ts
stories.details: Same changes as S-2.1 but applied to the blog.server.ts version.

epics.title: Frontend — Render Images & Galleries
epics.summary: Add custom img component handler, CollageGallery component, and gallery detection.

stories.title: Add img component handler to BlogPostContent
stories.details: Create custom `img` component for react-markdown. Parse pipe-separated alt for metadata. Render `<figure>` with `<Image>`, `<figcaption>` with caption + credit + source + license. All fields optional.

stories.title: Create CollageGallery component
stories.details: New file: src/components/blog/CollageGallery.tsx. Accepts `images` array and `layout` (2col/3col). Renders responsive CSS grid with figure elements. Each image has caption/credit support.

stories.title: Handle gallery rendering in blog post
stories.details: Add pre-processing step in BlogPostContent that converts `[gallery:...]...[/gallery]` markers to CollageGallery component renders. Handle in the react-markdown components or via pre-processing the content string.
